name: Apple Preview
summary: Apple's built-in viewer for PDFs and images on every Mac. Strong at PDFs, annotations, signing and quick image fixes like crop, resize and format conversion.
where_it_wins: Full PDF toolset: annotate, sign forms, combine, password-protect
Image editing: crop, resize, background removal, batch conversion
where_schnellbild_wins: Browses whole folders with a thumbnail grid instead of opening single files
Plays videos, including MKV, WebM, AVI
Opens ZIP/RAR/7z and comics as folders
File management: rename, trash, move/copy, dual pane
Slideshow through subfolders, photos and videos mixed
search_terms: preview app open folder of images

free.note: Included with macOS at no cost; no paid tier.

native_apple_silicon.note: Universal system app; binary is arm64e (local check on macOS 27.2 (codesign/lipo/sips on the installed system app)).

no_account_no_tracking.note: Opens local files without any account.

dark_light_setting.note: Follows the macOS Light/Dark appearance; Preview settings only change the window background colour.

languages_20.note: Follows the macOS system language (about 40 languages; 44 .lproj localisations in the app bundle).

folder_browsing.note: Opens files, not folders; several files can share one window with a thumbnail sidebar.

thumbnail_grid.note: Thumbnails / Contact Sheet of the files or pages opened in one window; no folder previews.

list_view.note: View menu offers Thumbnails, Contact Sheet, Table of Contents; no column list.

recursive_search.note: Search finds text inside PDFs, not file names in subfolders.

regex_search.note: Find matches the exact phrase or any word (Any Match); no regular expressions.

network_shares_fast.note: Opens individual files via File > Open or the Finder; does not browse folders or shares.

bookmarks.note: Bookmarks are for PDF pages only, not folders.

img_modern_formats.note: Reads HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP through macOS ImageIO (JPEG XL since macOS 14); exports HEIC.

img_psd_exr.note: Exports OpenEXR; PSD readable via ImageIO (local check on macOS 27.2 (codesign/lipo/sips on the installed system app)).

img_svg_pdf.note: PDF is Preview's core format; SVG support not documented in the guide (ImageIO reads SVG locally).

img_animated.note: Shows the frames of an animated GIF as stills; Apple points to Quick Look to play it.

keyboard_paging.note: Page Up/Down, Option-Page Up/Down between images in a window.

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom, actual size, rotate; rotating changes the file when saved.

slideshow.note: Guide documents slideshow for the pages of a PDF.

auto_enhance_view.note: Image adjustments change the file (auto-saved with versions); no view-only adjustments.

file_info_exif.note: Inspector with General info and More info (EXIF, GPS).

wrong_extension_note.note: Inspector shows general info, more info, keywords, encryption, crop, annotations; no file-type mismatch notice.

video_native.note: Preview opens PDFs, images and 3D files, not video.

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Preview User Guide table of contents (full feature list) covers PDFs, images and 3D files only; adds no Quick Look thumbnails.

archives_as_folders.note: Preview User Guide table of contents (full feature list) covers PDFs, images and 3D files only; no archives.

comics_cbz_cbr.note: Preview User Guide table of contents (full feature list) covers PDFs, images and 3D files only; no CBZ/CBR.

archive_passwords.note: Password protection is documented only for PDFs; no archives.

split_archives.note: Preview User Guide table of contents (full feature list) covers PDFs, images and 3D files only; no archives.

videos_in_archives.note: Preview User Guide table of contents (full feature list) covers PDFs, images and 3D files only; no video, no archives.

manga_two_page.note: Two Pages view for PDFs; no right-to-left mode.

rename_trash.note: Renames or moves the open file from the window title; no trash or new folder.

move_copy.note: Duplicate or Export the open file, move it via the title; no folder file management.

dual_pane.note: One document view with sidebar; Preview User Guide table of contents (full feature list) covers PDFs, images and 3D files only.

undo_file_actions.note: Undo and versions apply to edits of the document, not file operations.

image_editing.note: Crop, resize, rotate, flip, markup, background removal.

batch_convert.note: Convert, resize, rotate several images selected in one window's sidebar.

library_catalog.note: Only file keywords shown in the inspector; no catalog.

cloud_sync.note: Opens and saves documents in iCloud Drive.

keyboard_first.note: Many shortcuts, but no folder navigation by keyboard.

custom_shortcuts.note: macOS App Shortcuts can rebind menu commands of any app.

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Keyboard shortcut page in the Preview User Guide.

boss_key.note: Only the system-wide Command-H (hide app); no dedicated boss key.

app_sandbox.note: com.apple.security.app-sandbox entitlement (local check on macOS 27.2 (codesign/lipo/sips on the installed system app)).

no_network.note: No com.apple.security.network.client entitlement (local check on macOS 27.2 (codesign/lipo/sips on the installed system app)); sharing goes through system services.

notarized_attested.note: Signed by Apple as part of macOS, but closed source, so no build attestation.

mac_app_store.note: Ships with macOS; not a Mac App Store download.
